items.title: 12_Things Rejects The Conventions of Perfumery
items.summary: 'Challenging' isn't a word you'd normally use when describing perfumes and colognes, but its a term that's become somewhat of an inspiration for a new fragrance brand named 12_Things. Founded in London by Charlie Vickery, the brand has been built around a "rejection of conventional perfume language", resulting in notes taken from unexpected sources. Throughout the initial collection of eight fragrances, Vickery explores modern life, particularly one spent in the city.
